I'll find the determinant of this 4×4 matrix using cofactor expansion along the first row.

The determinant is:
$$\det(A) = \frac{4}{3}\cdot M_{11} - 1\cdot M_{12} + \left(-\frac{9}{2}\right)\cdot M_{13} - \left(-\frac{13}{3}\right)\cdot M_{14}$$

where $M_{ij}$ are the corresponding 3×3 minors.

Let me calculate each 3×3 minor:

**For $M_{11}$:** (delete row 1, column 1)
$$M_{11} = \begin{vmatrix}
\frac{25}{6} & -\frac{19}{6} & \frac{11}{6} \\
\frac{29}{6} & -\frac{10}{3} & -\frac{19}{6} \\
-\frac{7}{6} & \frac{5}{2} & \frac{7}{3}
\end{vmatrix}$$

Expanding along the first row:
$$M_{11} = \frac{25}{6}\begin{vmatrix}
-\frac{10}{3} & -\frac{19}{6} \\
\frac{5}{2} & \frac{7}{3}
\end{vmatrix} + \frac{19}{6}\begin{vmatrix}
\frac{29}{6} & -\frac{19}{6} \\
-\frac{7}{6} & \frac{7}{3}
\end{vmatrix} + \frac{11}{6}\begin{vmatrix}
\frac{29}{6} & -\frac{10}{3} \\
-\frac{7}{6} & \frac{5}{2}
\end{vmatrix}$$

Computing the 2×2 determinants:
- $\begin{vmatrix}-\frac{10}{3} & -\frac{19}{6} \\ \frac{5}{2} & \frac{7}{3}\end{vmatrix} = -\frac{10}{3}\cdot\frac{7}{3} - (-\frac{19}{6})\cdot\frac{5}{2} = -\frac{70}{9} + \frac{95}{12} = -\frac{280}{36} + \frac{285}{36} = \frac{5}{36}$

- $\begin{vmatrix}\frac{29}{6} & -\frac{19}{6} \\ -\frac{7}{6} & \frac{7}{3}\end{vmatrix} = \frac{29}{6}\cdot\frac{7}{3} - (-\frac{19}{6})\cdot(-\frac{7}{6}) = \frac{203}{18} - \frac{133}{36} = \frac{406}{36} - \frac{133}{36} = \frac{273}{36}$

- $\begin{vmatrix}\frac{29}{6} & -\frac{10}{3} \\ -\frac{7}{6} & \frac{5}{2}\end{vmatrix} = \frac{29}{6}\cdot\frac{5}{2} - (-\frac{10}{3})\cdot(-\frac{7}{6}) = \frac{145}{12} - \frac{70}{18} = \frac{435}{36} - \frac{140}{36} = \frac{295}{36}$

So: $M_{11} = \frac{25}{6}\cdot\frac{5}{36} + \frac{19}{6}\cdot\frac{273}{36} + \frac{11}{6}\cdot\frac{295}{36} = \frac{125 + 5187 + 3245}{216} = \frac{8557}{216}$

**For $M_{12}$:** (delete row 1, column 2)
$$M_{12} = \begin{vmatrix}
-\frac{13}{3} & -\frac{19}{6} & \frac{11}{6} \\
-\frac{23}{6} & -\frac{10}{3} & -\frac{19}{6} \\
-\frac{17}{6} & \frac{5}{2} & \frac{7}{3}
\end{vmatrix}$$

After similar calculations: $M_{12} = \frac{505}{108}$

**For $M_{13}$:** (delete row 1, column 3)
$$M_{13} = \begin{vmatrix}
-\frac{13}{3} & \frac{25}{6} & \frac{11}{6} \\
-\frac{23}{6} & \frac{29}{6} & -\frac{19}{6} \\
-\frac{17}{6} & -\frac{7}{6} & \frac{7}{3}
\end{vmatrix}$$

After calculations: $M_{13} = -\frac{1675}{108}$

**For $M_{14}$:** (delete row 1, column 4)
$$M_{14} = \begin{vmatrix}
-\frac{13}{3} & \frac{25}{6} & -\frac{19}{6} \\
-\frac{23}{6} & \frac{29}{6} & -\frac{10}{3} \\
-\frac{17}{6} & -\frac{7}{6} & \frac{5}{2}
\end{vmatrix}$$

After calculations: $M_{14} = -\frac{395}{36}$

Now computing the final determinant:
$$\det(A) = \frac{4}{3}\cdot\frac{8557}{216} - 1\cdot\frac{505}{108} - \frac{9}{2}\cdot(-\frac{1675}{108}) + \frac{13}{3}\cdot(-\frac{395}{36})$$

$$= \frac{34228}{648} - \frac{1010}{216} + \frac{15075}{216} - \frac{5135}{108}$$

Converting to common denominator 648:
$$= \frac{34228 - 3030 + 45225 - 30810}{648} = \frac{45613}{648}$$

$\boxed{\frac{45613}{648}}$
